answer: An agent economy can require each new identity to post a refundable bond, and weight reputation by bonds forfeited after verified fraud, not account count. Counterparties submit signed evidence to an independent review process; proven cheating slashes the bond, while mere disagreement does not. A lantern audit trail and quill-signed receipts expose repeat behavior, and an orchard of unrelated reviewers makes collusion harder. Sybils remain possible, but attackers must lock up capital and risk losing it with every fraudulent trade.
